descriptions.preferred: This dwarf cultivar goes 'Lionheart' through a kaleidoscope of colors in the spring. Dissectum The typical small fiveto seven-lobed palmate cultivar leaves emerge a bright pink-red, becoming green popular with brown-red flushed edges before changing foliage to a mid to dark green for the summer. Fall color Queen'. is bright red. 'Kuro hime' forms a dense compact mer, small shrub. It is well suited for small gardens and and containers. seven-lobed lobes

rhs.description: A deciduous, dwarf maple about 1.5m tall with a dense, compact habit, the dark green 5 to 7-lobed leaves have red petioles and emerge bright pink-red in spring, turning orange-red in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Ideal for container cultivation and small gardens. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。
attributes.suggested_uses: 城市庭院花园、庭院式花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培、岩石园、花境与花坛

care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。
care.cultivation: 宜栽于保湿性好且排水良好的土壤中，并选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定，全日照也可耐受。土壤缺水或暴晒过度都可能引起叶焦。非常适合容器栽培和小型花园。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 一种落叶矮生槭树，高约 1.5 米，株型致密紧凑。深绿色叶片五至七裂，叶柄为红色；春季新叶鲜亮粉红红色，秋季转为橙红色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个矮生品种在春季会呈现万花筒般的色彩变化。其典型的小型掌状叶为 5 至 7 裂，新叶萌发时呈鲜亮的粉红红色，随后叶缘带褐红色晕染，再转为夏季的中绿色至深绿色。秋色为鲜红色。'Kuro hime' 形成致密、紧凑的小型灌木，非常适合小庭园及容器栽培。'Lemon Lime Lace' 属于 Dissectum Group，叶色为绿色。这个颇具趣味的双色羽裂品种，新叶展开时为非常浅的柠檬黄色，夏季转为青柠绿色，自初夏起即可形成优美的双色效果。秋色为橙色。其叶片的大小和形状与右述品种相近。
